To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a) the best performing approach to generate descriptions of relationships in KGs is to use supervised methods that select a template based on the similarity between the relationship instance and the template, and b) the best performing template selection method is to use a combination of textual and KG information to select a template.

1) the supervised variation of our proposed approach is able to generate the most accurate and most informative descriptions; 2) our method is able to generate descriptions that are similar to descriptions written by humans.

(1) a supervised method outperforms an unsupervised method, (2) a supervised method that uses semantic similarity outperforms a supervised method that does not use semantic similarity, (3) a supervised method is better than a semi-supervised method, and (4) the best performing method uses a combination of semantic and lexical similarity to select the best template.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the automatic generation of human-readable descriptions for entity relationships in KGs.
automatically generating descriptions of entity relationships that are useful for search applications that utilize KG information.
generating textual descriptions of entity relations that can be used to improve the search user experience.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our method generates more accurate descriptions of entity relationships than the other variations.
the supervised method outperforms the unsupervised method.
our method generates high-quality descriptions of entity relationships that can be used to improve the search experience in KG-enabled applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our method generates descriptions of entity relationships that are more accurate and more contextual than other variations of our method and other state-of-the-art methods.
we have developed a system that generates human-readable descriptions of relationships between entities.
we propose a method that automatically creates human-readable descriptions of entity relationships in knowledge graphs, by utilizing the textual information available in the KG and the Web.
The main takeaway from our work is that
KG information alone is insufficient to create a high-quality description.
the combination of KG and textual information can be used to generate human-readable descriptions for KG relationships.
KGs are not only a good source for information, they can also be used to provide a better understanding of the information.
